speaker: john_heminges
text: The baskets are open. Crimson and murrey, over the charcoal. The tiring-house smells of old velvet and wormwood, and the light comes up through the poles. That is as dry as we get them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three nights. My lord's order wants the names. Fit them, and leave the rest.

speaker: john_heminges
text: St Stephen's. The Navarre comedy. Her Majesty has not seen it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: St John's, the lovers. I want the second night. A house that has supped will hear it. A house that has not will only hear the noise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten days old by then. I am not making them older on the page to flatter a feast.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Innocents' is mine to speak for. Give me Two Gentlemen, and the speech of the dog. She is never brought on. She costs nothing, and she does not bite a groundling.

speaker: george_bryan
text: She heard the dog at Greenwich. One does not tell her Majesty the same dog twice.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then something old, that we can get through a door. Errors. We know the walls.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: A year to the day from the afternoon we played it twice in two houses.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Or once. It depends who tells it, and whether he was paid for both.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Errors, then. Not thy dog, Will. I am not putting a deposition back into a book for her.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Garnish cuts the lovers to two hours and a half. The thumb-biting in the first scene goes. Her ears are not a Shoreditch yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I undertake it. No changes after the copying of the fourth, unless a playing fault demands one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The Master will hear them before she does. The sixteenth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At Clerkenwell. Write the place, or the next man will set it at the Theatre and be wrong.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Heminges and Bryan for the money. The money is not in the house. I will not pretend a purse we have not been paid.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Named, and not holding it. Do not ask me for a sum that has not come.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the hose, since we are particular where we are poor. My lord saw a heel. I saw Pope's.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You saw a heel. You did not see mine. Cowley wears the thin pair, and Cowley is not here to say so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is not here. Accuse him when he can answer. I am not writing a man's name into a hole.

speaker: john_heminges
text: New hose, the whole company, of the stock. No man brings his own. No man names a price tonight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys were settled yesterday. Arthur's hems are done. Nick's chest is not a subject for this pan. Nobody startles him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That stands. He is not in this room, and he will not be talked into it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Three nights. Stephen, John, Innocents. I have the second. You will have the lovers fit to be heard after supper, or I will say so when they are not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two hours and a half, and the thumb gone. I have undertaken the fourth. I am not offering you anything else to make the night look full.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The dog stays where she has already been heard. I am not so fond of a speech that I need it twice.

speaker: george_bryan
text: One dog is a story. The second would be a confession. We are done with her.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The velvet comes off the poles when it is dry. I am not choosing a fourth night by the smell of wormwood.
